register.title: Joost de Winter's packing of 199 squares at JoostdeWinter/square-packing 702c7af, issue 939
register.headline: De Winter's re-solve of T-284's packing at 199, 1.0399 of its margin through the L step; held
register.source_checks:
The issue says verify_exact.py, Python's standard library with fractions.Fraction, checks exact unit edge directions, containment and a separating-axis test on all 481 pairs of squares with centres closer than sqrt(2), and confirms by an exact sign test that the side lies within 1e-98 above the real root near 14.6147 of 62x^5 - 4426x^4 + 125017x^3 - 1746146x^2 + 12052670x - 32855154; that a second script with separate code checked the witness file in the same arithmetic; and that the two share one author, the separating-axis test and Python's Fraction. It says the certificate was not replayed with this repository's checkers.

The issue and README say the root is the local optimum of the arrangement, from a numerical solution of the optimality conditions to 130 digits, in which all 734 load-bearing or forced contacts close exactly and all other gaps stay open; the quintic was identified numerically from 108 digits and reproduces the side to 129 digits; local optimality has no formal proof. Those statements are the author's; no source program ran here.
register.credit:
Credit Joost de Winter (Delft University of Technology), who reports the re-solve of the n = 172 arrangement of issue 935 (T-282: Evan Daniel's packing, T-257, improved by Doğa Özden) to the exact local optimum of that arrangement, with the L of 27 unit squares along two walls that issue 938 (Doğa Özden, T-284, the house at 199) adds there: the classical L step s(n + 2 floor(s) + 1) <= s(n) + 1. The issue credits the core arrangement to Daniel and Özden.

The issue says the derivation, local optimization, high-precision solution, rational certificate, checks and figure were produced with Claude (Anthropic) under his direction.
register.next_rung: Held for the owner's question (think-ruu2's RV-3): whether a re-certification at the margin its predecessor carries, here through a construction, is a new result. If it is not, the entry is withdrawn and T-284 stays the house; if it is, the replay and the stage 4 review's clean-room run are entered, both rungs rise to V3 and C3, and 199 is adopted under the house rule with both strong generators' regularization and the flip, and think-wju3's solve at 172 is decided the same way. The stage 4 review of 11 November is mapped, at C1; only the evidence and the adoption wait on the owner.
